name: Export Italian packaging suppliers with websites

## Export Italian packaging suppliers with websites
Shortlist up to five Italian packaging suppliers. Each qualifying Europages profile has a company website. Use the city and profile link to review suppliers.

[Preview the preset on Apify](https://apify.com/perceptive_city_af7/europages-scraper/examples/find-italian-packaging-suppliers-with-websites)

1. Open **Download Italian packaging suppliers** and select a **Header Auth** credential. Set its name to `Authorization` and its value to `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`.
2. Click **Execute Workflow** once. This starts one Actor run on your Apify account, capped at **$0.03** and **5 rows**.
3. Open the HTTP node’s **Output → Binary → data** and download the CSV. If the request times out, check [your Apify runs](https://console.apify.com/actors/runs) before starting a second run.
